content: Independent FPL fan/tool sites (Fantasy Football Scout, LiveFPL, Fantasy Football Hub, etc.) commonly carry explicit 'not affiliated with / endorsed by the Premier League or its clubs' disclaimers and rely on nominative fair use (naming clubs/players in text, using official-hosted image assets) rather than hosting their own redistributed copies of trademarked crest/kit artwork. Specific first-party image-hotlinking practice (e.g. resources.premierleague.com badge CDN, fantasy.premierleague.com shirt CDN) was not directly confirmed by search results and should be spot-checked against current FPL API image URLs and ToS before relying on it long-term.
